content_sections.heading: About NIBMG Research Associate-I
content_sections.text: The National Institute of Biomedical Genomics (NIBMG), is an autonomous institution under the Department of Biotechnology (DBT), Government of India, and part of BRIC. This recruitment is intended for a research project with Principal Investigator Dr. Sagar Sengupta and Co-Principal Investigator Dr. Arindam Maitra. The appointment is initially for one year, which is extendable depending upon performance and requirements of the project.

rows.essential_qualification: Ph.D./MD/MS/MDS or equivalent degree or having 3 years of research, teaching and design and development experience after MVSc/M.Pharm/ME/M.Tech with atleast one research paper in Science Citation Indexed (SCI) journal.
rows.desirable_qualifications: Has at least one first author publication where the candidate has worked on human cells, animal models, biochemistry, molecular biology and imaging.

content_sections.heading: NIBMG Research Associate-I Job Description
content_sections.text: Should be capable of carrying out cell biology experiments in human cells, animal models, biochemistry, molecular biology and imaging. The candidate will be expected to do animal experiments, cell biology, molecular biology and biochemical assays in labs of collaborators outside NIBMG from time to time.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIBMG Research Associate-I
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed application format attached in the Page No. -3 of the official notification PDF. Fill out the C.V. in prescribed format completely. All the relevant attachment should be merged in a single PDF format. Send the application via email to [email protected] . Mention the subject line as “Application for the post of ………….” in Project “Investigating The Link Between P53 P300s Mutation And Colon Cancer Development Using Indian Patient Samples, Cellular And Animal Model Systems”. Ensure the application reaches within 12-11-2026 midnight.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Only the shortlisted candidates will be called for online interview. The decision of BRIC-NIBMG in all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of application, mode of selection, and conduct of interviews will be final and binding on the candidates.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: This position is contractual, and appointments will be initially for one year, which is extendable depending upon performance and requirements of the project. Original Certificate/testimonials in support of qualification & experience would be required to be shown at the time of interview & joining (if selected). Candidates shall bring the original degrees, certificates, and other documents in support of the above information for verification at the time of test/interview.
